notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.4 GR4: "the content of the status key data item of the area referenced by cd-name-1 is updated by the MCS". Every SEND runs through MessageControlSession.Statement, which ends with CommunicationArea.SetStatus at the format's status position (output 9-10, I-O 32-33) on success, refusal and 9x alike, and CommunicationEmitter.StoreArea stores the returned image back over the CD area, so every view of it (clause names, a user redefinition, a reference modification) sees the new key. Probed at --std 85: 00, 10, 20, 30, 50, 60, 80 and 91 on an output CD and 00/10/20/50 on an I-O CD each replaced a preset XX; the witness checks the key changed after a SEND to an unknown destination.
